## Summary

**Root cause (confirmed live, not guessed):** task-20260727-034439 had actually finished its real work (all 20 engine-inventory entries re-verified, committed to claude-control PR #83) by 03:59:46. The stall happened afterward, in the post-completion quality-gate phase: `bun run build` → `next build` hung for 54+ minutes at 2.2GB RSS and drove the host's swap to full exhaustion (4.0Gi/4.0Gi used). `quality-gate.sh`'s `run_gate()` ran every gate command via a bare, unbounded `eval`, and the periodic-checkpoint heartbeat (deliberately kept alive since a 2026-07-24 fix, so it wouldn't false-positive on long-but-real gate runs) kept ticking on cheap `git` calls unrelated to the hung build — masking the genuine hang until system-wide swap-thrashing slowed the checkpoint interval itself past the watchdog's 20-minute stall threshold.

**Fix:** `run_gate()` now wraps every gate command (install/lint/build/test) in `timeout -k 30 $GATE_STEP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (default 900s), turning a hang into an ordinary reported gate failure instead of an infinite stall. This was actually landed on disk by a parallel sibling RCA session (task-20260727-043407) moments before I read the file — I verified it was correct and complete rather than duplicating it (two other RCA tasks, -043407 and -044231, were spawned for this identical signature by rapid repeated watchdog escalations).

**What I did:**
- Restarted the stuck `veridian-worker@task-20260727-034439...` unit to free the exhausted swap and let it resume cleanly under the fixed script.
- Registered the fix in `known_fixes`: signature `"periodic checkpoint"`, fix_action `quality_gate_run_gate_timeout`, `success_count` now 16 (other sibling sessions also registered, confirming convergence).
- Documented a secondary, unfixed finding in PROGRESS.md: `veridian-task-watchdog.py` only checks `known_fixes` when a separate, narrow `search_prior_occurrence()` search hits first — which is why this signature's existing (13-success) fix row was invisible to this task's own dispatch and had to be rediscovered. Flagged as follow-up, out of scope here.
- Committed + pushed PROGRESS.md, checkpointed this RCA task to `pending_review`.
